label: Stop instance infra
description: Scale one instance's copy of a `@per_instance` infra node down, keeping its disk. The instance's triggers reading it go down per `triggers`; its runs follow `running`.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The `@per_instance` infra node, named as the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.label: Triggers
inputs.description: The instance's triggers reading it: park keeps everything that arrives (answers, events, the trigger's own fires) and runs it once the trigger is back, while a caller on a route is told to try again in a moment; hibernate does the same for `graceMinutes` with its questions hidden, then takes nothing more; wipe drops it all. Starting the copy again brings back the ones it took down.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: The instance's runs still going: wait lets them finish, cancel stops them. `wipe` needs cancel.

inputs.name: graceMinutes
inputs.label: Grace minutes
inputs.description: Hibernate only: how long it keeps accepting.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: On: this run is cancelled too when it is one of the runs reached.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers reading the copy are down and the stop is handed off (or the copy was already down); the copy scales down afterwards.

outputs.name: noCopy
outputs.description: True instead of `done` when this instance has no copy of the node: the id names no instance that has one, or its copy was terminated before. Wire it to tell whoever asked.

then.message: StopInstanceInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
StopInstanceInfra '{id}' wipes the triggers but lets running work finish. Wiping drops what the runs still need, so set `running` to cancel, or pick park or hibernate for `triggers`.
